paragraphs: Grand Strand Sandwich Company is recalling four biscuit sandwich products due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination: Lunch Box Chicken Sausage Biscuit (3.75 oz), Lunch Box Sausage Egg & Cheese Biscuit (5 oz), Lunch Box Jumbo Sausage Biscuit (4 oz), and Lunch Box Bacon Egg and Cheese Biscuit (4 oz) [2]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC has expanded its recall to include Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches and Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy, also due to potential Listeria contamination from products made at its Longview, Texas facility [4].

Shanghai San Niu Food Co., Ltd. is recalling Sanniu Evergreen Biscuits due to undeclared milk and Sanniu Salt and Pepper Soda Biscuits due to undeclared milk and shrimp [1]. ALDI is recalling Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni because they may not have been stored at appropriate temperatures, potentially allowing pathogen growth including Clostridium botulinum [5]. Naia, Inc. is recalling Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto with code dates of 10/5/2027, 10/6/2027, 10/7/2027, and 10/8/2026 due to undeclared tree nuts (pistachio), milk, and eggs [6].

Larbi Inc. is recalling three lots of Herb To Body Yellow Dock Root C/S 4oz due to potential Salmonella contamination [3]. An E. coli outbreak at Ohio University has grown to 17 confirmed cases among students [13], and an E. coli outbreak at Tufts University had five confirmed cases as of November 19 [8].
